faq_heading: Quilchena real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Quilchena is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 52 homes sold there: 19 houses, 25 condos and 8 townhomes. 25 condos sold in Quilchena with a median price of $930,000 (the middle half sold between $850,000 and $1,212,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list.
Quilchena home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

25 condos sold in Quilchena with a median price of $930,000 (the middle half sold between $850,000 and $1,212,000), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $1,039 per square foot, a median year built of 2003 and a median strata fee of $593 a month. 19 houses sold in Quilchena with a median price of $3,550,000 (the middle half sold between $2,996,944 and $4,475,000), taking a median of 39 days to sell at 93.6% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $982 per square foot, a median year built of 1965 and a median lot of 7,019 square feet.

faq.q: What did condos in Quilchena sell for?
faq.a: 25 condos sold in Quilchena between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $930,000.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in Quilchena?
faq.a: The median was 24 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.8% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most condos in Quilchena sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 25 condos that sold in Quilchena went for between $850,000 and $1,212,000, around a median of $930,000.

faq.q: Do condos in Quilchena sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 25 condos sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for condos in Quilchena?
faq.a: Of the 25 sales, 25 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $593.

faq.q: How old are the condos that sold in Quilchena?
faq.a: The median year built was 2003 for the 25 condos sold in Quilchena.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do condos in Quilchena usually have?
faq.a: The median condo that sold in Quilchena had 2 bedrooms, from the 25 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
